heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of a late-day shower or thunderstorm in New York and in the Champlain Valley. Highs from upper 70s to mid 80s. South winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of showers and thunderstorms south of Route 4, likely early to the north, then diminishing overnight. Lows in the upper 50s to lower 60s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west and diminishing, except continuing at 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. Slight chance of a shower, mainly over high terrain, and in the valleys near the Vermont/Québec border. Less humid, with highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s, with some mid 80s in southeastern valleys, and some lower 70s northeast and in the Adirondacks. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph.
